description: Google Search Light. Scrape lightweight Google Search results via API: fast, cost-efficient, organic results only. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

cr.description: Limit results to one or more countries. Use country{XX} with | as delimiter (e.g. countryFR|countryDE).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country to use for the Google search. Two-letter country code (e.g. us for the United States, uk for United Kingdom, or fr for France).

google_domain.description: Google domain to use for the search. Defaults to google.com. Default: "google.com".

hl.description: Language to use for the Google search. Two or three-letter language code (e.g. en, es, fr), optionally followed by a region code (e.g. en-gb, es-419).

lr.description: Limit results to one or more languages. Use lang_{xx} with | as delimiter (e.g. lang_fr|lang_de).

query.description: The search query you want to run on Google (supports advanced operators like site:, inurl:, intitle:).

name: google_search_light
title: Google Search Light
